methods: Calculated SHA-256, byte size and page count for every supplied PDF and compared each hash with every published catalog.
Opened and fingerprinted all 809 pages; 736 pages supplied embedded text and 73 sparse or image-only pages received GPU-assisted OCR.
Visually verified each supplied first page and the only low-text page requiring direct review, a valid site photograph on PDF page 110 of the May 21, 2018 council packet.
Reused every byte-identical published record as a cross reference and created no filename-based duplicate.

queueDecision: No evidence-request item is closed. These seven uploads are exact copies of records already evaluated and placed in the supplemental archive. They add no new delivery-level receiving history, invoices, executed agreements, cessation record, synchronized treatment sampling, certified well construction, hydraulic testing or source-to-receptor PFAS package.
evidentiaryBoundary: The financial reports and packets corroborate aggregate treatment, revenue and public-response context. They do not convert budget figures into load-level proof, turn the unsigned 2798 resolution text into an executed form, or establish PFAS treatment pass-through or a groundwater migration pathway.
